bullets: • Scope CSS patches to single property modifications per submission when possible.
• Validate version.json updates correspond to stylesheet changes in unified diffs.
• Extract actual CSS values from diffs; reject metadata-only or changelog-only patches.
• Assert modified property values in tests against parsed style block source.
• Document CSS property changes with before/after values in patch descriptions.
• Expand test coverage beyond CSS constraints to validate multi-file interactions.
• Prioritize well-defined acceptance criteria; escalate ambiguous requirements before coding.
• Prepare multi-file refactors and feature-scope tasks for upcoming sprint validation.
